rule_text.name: 702.296a
rule_text.rule: Derange is a static ability that functions while the spell with derange is on the stack. “Derange N” means “As you cast this spell, you may mill exactly N cards.”

rule_text.name: 702.296b
rule_text.rule: A player with fewer than N cards in their library won't be able to mill any cards.

rule_text.name: 702.296c
rule_text.rule: A copy of a spell with derange won't be able to mill cards, unless the effect specifically casts a copy.
